mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with declining FEDFUNDS over 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for three consecutive months, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in non-farm payrolls signals labor market tightening that accelerates wage growth and corporate profit margins, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint movement of UNRATE decline and PAYEMS increase fails to produce positive 20-day returns in >60% of instances, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, housing starts (HOUST) below 1200 thousand units signals housing sector weakness that reduces consumer spending and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of HOUST < 1200 periods during late-cycle expansion, or regime-specific Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) over the prior 3 months indicates strong consumer spending that supports corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of RSAFS increase periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 110 for two consecutive months, it signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of INDPRO < 110 periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), a decline in unemployment rate below 5.0% signals labor market recovery that boosts consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >60% of UNRATE < 5.0% periods during high-unemployment regime, or regime-specific Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in CPI inflation and decline in housing starts signals stagflationary pressure that reduces real disposable income, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint movement of CPIAUCSL rise and HOUST decline fails to produce negative 20-day returns in >60% of instances, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.
